Are you new to Mexico or do you like to make new friends? Then come to ISM (International Salsa Meetup). No experience needed, no partner required, feel free to join our ISM community and say hello! *   Time Limit to Use Your Hours: You have 2 months from the date of purchase to use all your private class hours. After this period, no refunds will be issued.

*   Same-Day Cancellations: If you cancel on the same day as your class, the session will be counted as used and no refund or rescheduling will be possible.

*   Advance Cancellations: If you cancel at least 12 hours in advance, the class can be rescheduled at no additional cost.

*   Unscheduled Classes – Student Responsibility: If more than 2 months pass and classes have not been scheduled due to the student’s delay, no refund will be provided for unused hours.

*   Unscheduled Classes – Teacher Responsibility: If classes have not been scheduled due to the teacher’s unavailability, you may request a refund for the remaining hours.
